tools.title: JetBrains Rider + UnrealLink / RiderLink
tools.summary: Deep Rider/Unreal Editor integration with Blueprint awareness, code navigation, game launch control and enhanced Unreal logs.
why: Navigate from C++ to the corresponding Blueprint in Unreal Editor
Run multiplayer configurations from the IDE
Use Unreal-aware inspections/refactors and filtered editor logs
workflow: Install/open the project in JetBrains Rider.
Install RiderLink into the game or engine when prompted.
Use Find Usages to include Blueprint-derived/reference information.
Launch PIE/server/client configurations and inspect Unreal logs directly from Rider.
tools.codex: Useful companion IDE when Codex edits C++; it provides human verification of reflection usage and Blueprint/C++ coupling.
tools.caution: Rider is a separate commercial IDE depending on your license; RiderLink should match the Rider/engine setup.

tools.title: UnrealXistTools
tools.summary: Cross-platform PowerShell 7 helpers for Unreal project discovery, UAT, clean builds, project files, IDE launch and project refactors.
why: Wraps verbose Unreal command lines in repeatable scripts
Works on Windows, macOS and Linux for many commands
workflow: Clone UnrealXistTools and add it to PATH.
Use UAT.ps1 for build-cook-stage flows and UProjectClean.ps1 for deliberate clean rebuilds.
tools.codex: Reference implementation for shell automation. We can borrow patterns or call equivalent project-local scripts rather than make Codex reconstruct UAT flags every time.
tools.caution: Review every cleanup/refactor command before running it on a working project; destructive switches should never be implicit.
